visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle shot from inside a green shopping basket, looking up at a young man with black hair wearing a light-colored sweatshirt. He smiles and looks directly into the camera lens. The scene quickly cuts to him standing inside a brightly lit drugstore aisle, walking towards the camera while gesturing. He wears a black backpack and a silver chain necklace. The background shows shelves stocked with various colorful health and beauty products under bright white fluorescent lights. (2) The man introduces the first product, a blue and pink anti-mosquito spray. He holds it close to the camera, showing the Japanese labels and the Kincho logo. The scene shifts to a bathroom shelf where several spray bottles are organized. A graphic overlay shows him pressing the spray nozzle, followed by a cartoon animation of a mosquito flying and then falling with 'X' eyes, indicating it has been eliminated. The lighting is bright and even throughout the scene. (3) The countdown continues with a wet-mask product. The man shows a white face mask and separate moistening pads. He demonstrates how to insert the pads into the mask pockets. The scene cuts to him lying in a bed with grey plaid bedding, wearing the mask and giving a thumbs up. Cartoon graphics depict an air conditioner blowing cold air onto a shivering man in a suit, contrasting with a woman sleeping peacefully with the mask on. (4) For the third item, the man holds a brown mug while rubbing his stomach, appearing satisfied. He shows a box of 'Mori Mori Slim' tea which features a brown cartoon poop emoji. He pulls a tea bag from the box and places it into the mug. A close-up shot shows clear hot water being poured over the tea bag, with the dark tea liquid beginning to diffuse. The background is a simple indoor kitchen or living area. (5) The fourth item is a bottle of IROKA fabric softener. The man is seen in a laundry or bathroom area with white shirts hanging on a rack. He sniffs the bottle with an expression of bliss and then smells the clean laundry. A cartoon graphic of two businessmen shaking hands appears, with speech bubbles in Chinese. He playfully wraps a white shirt around his head, looking directly at the camera with a happy, relaxed facial expression. (6) The video transitions to an exterior shot of the SUGI Pharmacy store at 'Shibadaimon.' The man stands outside the entrance, which has a large red and white sign with Japanese text. He points towards the store. The scene cuts back inside to show the wide aisles, a staff member's name badge with 'Chen' written on it, and a view of the Tokyo Tower in the distance between urban buildings. The camera uses walking handheld movements to create a sense of exploration. (7) A full-screen graphic appears with a white background and red accents. It features a large QR code and discount information: '10% + 8% OFF'. There are social media handles and 'SUGI Pharmacy' branding. The text is dense but clearly organized for viewers to screenshot. (8) The final product is a Nivea Deep Moisture Lip Balm. A bowl full of various lip balms is shown. The man takes the yellow lip balm and applies it to his lips while closing his eyes in enjoyment. In the final shot, he opens his mouth wide as if he is about to bite into the lip balm, with an exaggerated expression of surprise and delight. The lighting remains bright and focused on his face.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel-shopping guide for Taiwanese tourists visiting Japan, specifically promoting SUGI Pharmacy. By ranking five 'must-buy' daily necessity products with humor and high-energy narration, it creates a sense of urgency and utility. The inclusion of store location details (Tokyo Tower proximity) and a high-value discount coupon transforms the entertaining content into a practical tool for travelers, ultimately driving foot traffic and sales to the specific retail chain.
